mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 9.0% signals an ongoing economic recession, causing immediate risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and rising), the increased cost of capital and reduced liquidity lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and has risen by more than 0.1pp in the last 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts level below 500,000 units signals a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has declined for at least 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS declines and HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly annualized inflation rate above 3.0% signals an accelerating price environment, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.0.
